confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors align with recent Copenhagen visitor guidance and city cost-of-living aggregates. The cocktail figure comes from thin, crowd-sourced October 2026 data; the wine-glass figure is estimated from its local relationship to beer. Accommodation anchors are bounded holistic estimates without live listing checks and vary strongly by season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Copenhagen is comparable to Stockholm, Oslo and central Amsterdam in its high Nordic and northern European restaurant prices and strong tourist demand; accommodation estimates reflect that expensive-city profile.
